exactInputs.section: Upper complex-organic geometry / receptor and S/E kit

findings.observedProblem: The original bilingual task describes L/L2 as supplied different spatial poses and requires an actual analogue spacing comparison. The available kit instead calls for a teacher-supplied spatial kit/cards, states that L2 is deliberately misaligned and leaves the arrangement unprovided. No finite actual L/L2 pose pair, receptor contact layout, distances/coordinates or unambiguous physical construction/contact rule was found. Thus a learner can repeat the supplied fit label but cannot independently test that supplied pair from these exact materials.
findings.requiredTargetedRemediation: Provide a finite reproducible receptor-contact layout and both posed versions of the same hypothetical amide/phenyl ligand, with explicit matching/spacing rules and amide/tetrahedral/phenyl constraints; bind the operative case/material and retain the original archive. A clearly supplied printable/analogue construction that lets the learner test rather than receive the fit verdict is sufficient. Keep the digital K/occupancy work, full context union and unchanged valid image assets.
